scope: Receipt-only native DFlash2 measurement; no profile, package or runtime modification
runtime: fc3208dbb9fe166f1dff1341a0a099057ae8a878 or the exact integrated N build; each receipt binds its actual binary and source

roles.runner: KernelRoutes tools/bench/run_exp097.py request construction and log binding, adapted for native Windows
roles.equality: Canonical content, reasoning and tool names/arguments hashes; transport IDs excluded
roles.performance: Server decode time; report median and weighted tokens/sec, acceptance, rounds, tokens/round, ms/round and workload nearest-rank p95

fit.search: Binary search between fitting and unfitting page counts; no rerun of the assignment's known-unfit 4090 131072 input. A fit requires readiness, a 64-token decode probe and nonnegative CUDA spare after the lane floor. Report adjacent page boundary, or exact non-memory initialization/execution failure instead of relabeling it OOM.
fit.matched_comparison: Both arms use the same measured largest DFlash2 context and all lane settings above
fit.limit: Boundary is conditional on observed free VRAM and this process shape; not a full-context retrieval, C2 or durable-store qualification

leak_screen.scope: EXP-085's redaction subset only, not its full multi-metric quality verdict
leak_screen.determinism: EXP-063 fresh-server v0/v1 per control, 14 prompts per arm
leak_screen.confidence: one-sided paired 95 percent, stratified within control
leak_screen.pass_rule: Every validity check holds, leak-ratio upper bound <1.10 and redaction pass-rate delta lower bound >-0.05
leak_screen.validity: 504 scored rows in both arms, <=1 percent errors, >=4 controls perturbed in each arm, all 14 fresh-server repeats byte-identical

operations.priority: lowest; explicit Integrator6 grant per card; qualification and final acceptance take precedence
operations.resources: Isolated scratch and owned subprocesses; never installed runtime roots or production port
operations.vram: nvidia-smi samples every two seconds plus CUDA startup memory breakdown
operations.privacy: Only numerical measurements, case identifiers and hashes in committed receipts; no raw prompt/output/secret or private paths
